name: worm-vue3-print
description: Vue 3 可视化打印模板设计器 + 表达式引擎 + 同构渲染管线（开源 monorepo）

scripts.build: npm run build -w @go-wind/print-core && npm run build -w @go-wind/print-render && npm run build -w @go-wind/print-canvas && npm run build -w @go-wind/print-common && npm run build -w @go-wind/print-client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @go-wind/print-core && npm run test -w @go-wind/print-canvas && npm run test -w @go-wind/print-common && npm run test -w @go-wind/print-client
scripts.pack:client:dir: npm run build -w @go-wind/print-core && npm run pack:dir -w @go-wind/print-client
scripts.pack:client: npm run build -w @go-wind/print-core && npm run build -w @go-wind/print-client && npm exec -w @go-wind/print-client -- electron-builder --mac --win
scripts.pack:client:linux: npm run build -w @go-wind/print-core && npm run build -w @go-wind/print-client && node scripts/pack-client-linux.mjs
scripts.publish:local: npm run build && npm -w @go-wind/print-core exec yalc push && npm -w @go-wind/print-canvas exec yalc push
scripts.publish:npm: npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w @go-wind/print-core --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && npm publish -w @go-wind/print-canvas --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w @go-wind/print-core --dry-run --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && npm publish -w @go-wind/print-canvas --dry-run --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public
scripts.publish:common:beta: npm run build -w @go-wind/print-core && npm run build -w @go-wind/print-canvas && npm run build -w @go-wind/print-common && npm test -w @go-wind/print-core && npm test -w @go-wind/print-canvas && npm test -w @go-wind/print-common && npm publish -w @go-wind/print-common --tag next --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && node scripts/check-common-dist-tag.mjs --fix
scripts.publish:common:dry-run: npm run build -w @go-wind/print-core && npm run build -w @go-wind/print-canvas && npm run build -w @go-wind/print-common && npm test -w @go-wind/print-core && npm test -w @go-wind/print-canvas && npm test -w @go-wind/print-common && npm publish -w @go-wind/print-common --dry-run --tag next --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && node scripts/check-common-dist-tag.mjs --dry-run --warn-only
